== Biography ==
John was born before 1730. He is the son of [[Glasgow-1075|Robert Glasgow]] and [[Allan-4046|Margaret Allan]].
== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-1075]] is assessed at 98% (proved). John’s 29 March 1731 Puddockholm entry explicitly names Robert Glasgow, Surgeon, and Margarat Allan. Place, trade and wife identify Robert-1075 despite the 1730 year in the older citation/field.

Recorded surgeon father, independent of the 1730/1731 calendar or transcription discrepancy.

Next useful test: Compare FamilySearch XY24-V6J with OPR596/1 p79 and original calendar wording.
